ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 30% high-intensity (white) to 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white field located on the distal half of the right lobe; secondary white field on the distal tip of the left lobe. Solid low-intensity black pigmentation dominates the medial region, base, and proximal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 10% into the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude 'sawtooth' serrations along the trailing edge of the right lobe; moderate-frequency serrations visible on the left lobe trailing edge, partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins follow a convex geometric curve tapering to acute, sharp-angled distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of 5-7 discrete, low-intensity circular pixel groups (dark spots) localized within the high-intensity white patch of the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 2-3 dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions crossing the white pigmentation field on the upper right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and localized pitting along the trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with mechanical trauma or previous appendage interactions.
